sources: [S4-COMPLETE] driver-spec.txt sec 4 - finishes without error MUST be complete
[S4-STOPPED] driver-spec.txt sec 4 - halts on a defined condition MUST be stopped
[S4-FAILED] driver-spec.txt sec 4 - halts for any other reason MUST be failed
[S4-NOT-STOPPED] driver-spec.txt sec 4 - such a stage MUST NOT be recorded stopped
[S4-PARTIAL] driver-spec.txt sec 4 - wrote some artifacts then halted MUST be stopped
[S4-ATTEMPTED] driver-spec.txt sec 4 - pending means not attempted in this workdir
